summary: Indonesia Energy Corporation Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements as of June 30, 2026, and an Operating and Financial Review for the six-month periods ended June 30, 2026 and 2025. The filing is incorporated by reference into the company's effective Form F-3 shelf registration (File No. 333-278175). No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural event is disclosed. This is a routine interim-results furnishing by a foreign private issuer; there is no deal, no special-situation angle, and no risk-arb catalyst to watch.
